description: This file contains selector functions for accessing and computing post-related state in a Mattermost web application, including post editing status, visibility of embedded content and images, and permissions for thread wrangling.

methods.name: getIsPostBeingEdited
methods.description: Checks if a specific post is currently being edited based on global state and post ID.

methods.name: getIsPostBeingEditedInRHS
methods.description: Checks if a specific post is being edited in the right-hand sidebar (RHS).

methods.name: getPostEditHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the edit history of posts from the global state.

methods.name: getEditingPostDetailsAndPost
methods.description: Selector that combines editing post details with the post object itself.

methods.name: isEmbedVisible
methods.description: Determines if an embed for a post is visible based on user preferences and global storage.

methods.name: isInlineImageVisible
methods.description: Determines if an inline image within a post is visible based on user preferences and global storage.

methods.name: makeCanWrangler
methods.description: Creates a selector function that determines if the current user can perform thread wrangling actions based on configuration, user roles, email domain, reply count, and channel type.
